name: waiting-on-chaser
description: Finds what YOU asked other people for in your own sent email and chat over the last 14 days (3 to 30 if you ask) that has had no reply: a review, an approval, a decision, your input, a deliverable. It checks each ask for a later answer from that person and ranks who you are waiting on by days waiting, deadline, what is blocked and who they are (your manager, an outside contact), with the ask quoted, the deadline, what it blocks and a link to your message. Asks it can't back with a message you sent are left out; ones that may already be answered are listed apart and never nudged by default. On request it drafts a nudge, light or firm to match the delay, in the same thread, and sends it only after you approve that exact text, one draft at a time. Not what you owe other people, and not a task manager.

skills.name: Waiting on others
skills.description: Your own unanswered asks from your sent email and chat in the last 14 days (3-30): who you are waiting on, what you asked, days waiting, deadline, what is blocked, source link, ranked. Then a nudge per ask, light or firm, sent only after you approve the exact text.
examples: What have I asked people for in the last 3 weeks that's still unanswered?
